description: This file defines a Java interface 'PermissionReadPlatformService' that declares methods for retrieving permission data within the Fineract platform, used for user administration tasks.

classes.name: PermissionReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface providing methods to retrieve different sets of permission data.

methods.name: retrieveAllMakerCheckerablePermissions
methods.description: Retrieves all permissions that can be checked or approved (maker/checker permissions).

methods.name: retrieveAllRolePermissions
methods.description: Retrieves permissions associated with a specific role identified by roleId.
